name: @emit/react
description: React bindings for @emit/logger — hooks, context provider, and server action wrapper

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir=dist --target=node --format=esm --external=react --external=react-dom --external=@emit/logger && bun build ./src/index.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs --external=react --external=react-dom --external=@emit/logger && bun build ./src/server.ts --outdir=dist --target=node --format=esm --external=@emit/logger && bun build ./src/server.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/server.cjs --external=@emit/logger
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:types
